opening.text: I've had diarrhea or I've been going to the toilet more often, and my muscles ache all over. I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe, and I have a cough. In the last 4 weeks I travelled to West Africa. In the last month I've been in contact with someone infected with Ebola. In the past 2 weeks I've been around someone with similar symptoms.
